_what: Drives pipeline.mjs. Prose lives in _-prefixed keys so there is no second document to drift from.
_assets: Where install puts what the game loads. The game root, not public/ — Vite full-page-reloads on any publicDir change, which defeats the hot swap.
_stages: Run in order. Each skips when its outputs exist and sha256(input bytes + that stage's config) matches out/.hashes.json. --force overrides.

mesh._backend: UNSET. See stages/mesh.mjs for the options and what each costs. Set backend + command to enable.

rig._backend: UNSET, and this is the open question of the phase — nothing has rigged a generated mesh here yet. See stages/rig.mjs.

canonicalise._what: Blender. No configuration: the contract is not negotiable per character.
canonicalise._map: Reads out/<name>.bones.json, which npm run retry:map proposes. It refuses while reviewed is false.

install._what: Validate against the contract, then copy. No bone map is installed — under the contract the joints ARE the spec's names.

characters.name: kaida
characters._ref: Human-selected over kaida-plain.png: its legs carry a visible gap, and plain merges the thighs into one mass which reconstruction fuses into a single limb.

characters.name: probe
characters._what: Harness entry, not a game character. Its rigged input is a stock Mixamo rig copied into out/ by hand, so canonicalise and install can be exercised end to end while the mesh and rig backends are still undecided. Delete when they are not.
